description: This file defines the chat store and related functions for managing chat sessions, messages, and interactions with AI models in a chat application. It includes functions for creating messages, managing sessions, handling user input, summarizing conversations, and migrating persisted state.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a new chat message with a unique ID, current date, and default role 'user', merging any overrides.

methods.name: createEmptySession
methods.description: Initializes a new empty chat session with default values.

methods.name: getSummarizeModel
methods.description: Determines the appropriate model to use for summarization based on the current model.

methods.name: countMessages
methods.description: Calculates the total token length of a list of messages.

methods.name: fillTemplateWith
methods.description: Fills a template string with variables such as service provider, cutoff date, model, time, language, and input.
